name: bargnani
caption:
PICK 1 🎮🏀 We took Andrea Bargnani first overall. The trade that sent him away is still paying off.

• 2006 draft: Bargnani #1, LaMarcus Aldridge #2
• Best season with us (2010-11): 21.4 PPG
• July 10, 2013: traded to the Knicks for 3 players and a 2016 first
• That pick: #9 in 2016, Jakob Poeltl
• Poeltl, his 8 games this season: 6.5 RPG, 64.6 FG%

Bust, or a pick that's still paying off? 👇

beats.head: PICK 1
beats.name: BARGNANI
beats.vo: We took Andrea Bargnani first overall. LaMarcus Aldridge went second.

beats.head: BEST SEASON
beats.name: BARGNANI
beats.vo: His best year with us: twenty-one point four points a night. But we never won a playoff series with him.
beats.dlg: HIS BEST SEASON WITH US:|21.4 PPG.

beats.head: TO NEW YORK
beats.name: BARGNANI
beats.vo: In twenty thirteen, we traded him to the Knicks. The key piece coming back: a twenty sixteen first-round pick.
beats.dlg: 2013: BARGNANI TO NEW YORK|FOR A 2016 FIRST.

beats.head: THE PICK
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: That pick became number nine in twenty sixteen: Jakob Poeltl.

beats.head: STILL HERE
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: And he's still our center: in his eight games this season, six point five rebounds on sixty-four point six percent shooting.

beats.head: BUST?
beats.vo: Bust, or a pick that's still paying off? Comment below.

facts.claim: Bargnani selected first overall (#1) by Toronto in the 2006 draft; on 10 July 2013 (July 10) traded to the New York Knicks for Steve Novak, Marcus Camby and Quentin Richardson (3 players), a 2016 first-round pick and two second-round picks
2006 draft: Bargnani #1 to Toronto, LaMarcus Aldridge picked 2nd (#2)
2016 draft pick 9 (#9): Jakob Pöltl to the Toronto Raptors (from Denver via New York), citing the 2013 Raptors-Knicks trade
